title: Quasi-coherence of higher direct images
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. For every $q\in\mathbf N$, the higher direct image $R^q f_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent on $T$.

source.place: Tag 01XJ (1), quasi-coherence of higher direct images

proof.text: Restrict to affine opens of the base and apply the ordinary higher-image quasi-coherence theorem for quasi-compact quasi-separated morphisms; transport the resulting ordinary right-derived statement to Scheme.Modules.higherDirectImage by definitional identification of the module direct image and its right derived functor.
